title: Quantum models of the Riemann zeta function, lattice spin models and algebraic models of entanglement
summary: A brief overview of results concerning the connection between the Hilbert-Polya conjecture and the Riemann hypothesis about the Riemann zeta function, some new results on p-adic quantum computing, quantum entanglement based on lattice spin models and algebraic entanglement models is given. Quantum computing uses both photons and electrons, so their known properties are (very briefly) presented.
